reason: The request involves a refund past the 14-day window plus an explicit chargeback threat, both of which require escalation to a human per policy.
reply:
Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the frustration around this charge.

I want to clarify our refund policy, since it's a bit different from what you described: full refunds are available for requests made within 14 calendar days of the charge date. Requests made after that 14-day window aren't eligible for a standard refund — those can only be approved as a goodwill exception by a support manager. Since you mentioned the charge occurred 40 days ago, this falls outside the standard refund window.

That said, because you've raised the possibility of a chargeback, I'm escalating this to our team for review right away rather than handling it as a routine request. A member of our team will follow up with you directly to look into the charge and discuss next steps. I'm not able to approve or process a refund myself, so please hold off on any further action until you hear back from them.

Thanks for your patience while this gets reviewed.
